  · -- 108 is in the set (witness a=12, b=54)

  · -- 108 ≤ y for all y in the set
    rcases hy with ⟨a, b, h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, rfl⟩
    have h₄ : Nat.gcd a b = 6 := h₃
    have h₅ : a % 10 = 2 := h₁
    have h₆ : b % 10 = 4 := h₂
    -- Since gcd(a,b)=6, write a=6m, b=6n with gcd(m,n)=1
    have h₇ : 6 ∣ a := by
      have : Nat.gcd a b ∣ a := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
      rwa [h₄] at this
    have h₈ : 6 ∣ b := by
      have : Nat.gcd a b ∣ b := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
      rwa [h₄] at this
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := h₇
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := h₈

      rwa [h₄] at this

    have h₁₁ : (6 * n) % 10 = 4 := h₆

      have h₁₃ : (6 * m) % 5 = 2 % 5 := by
        omega
      have : (6 * m) % 5 = (6 % 5 * (m % 5)) % 5 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
      have : 6 % 5 = 1 := by decide
      rw [this] at h₁₃
      have : (1 * (m % 5)) % 5 = 2 % 5 := by rwa [← h₁₃]
      have : m % 5 = 2 := by
        have : (m % 5) % 5 = 2 := by
          simp [Nat.mul_one] at this; assumption
        have h₁₄ : m % 5 < 5 := Nat.mod_lt m (by decide)
        omega
      exact this
    -- From 6n ≡ 4 (mod 10): 3n ≡ 2 (mod 5), so n ≡ 4 (mod 5)
    have h₁₃ : n % 5 = 4 := by
      have : (6 * n) % 10 = 4 := h₁₁
      have h₁₄ : (6 * n) % 5 = 4 % 5 := by
        omega
      have : (6 * n) % 5 = (6 % 5 * (n % 5)) % 5 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
      have : 6 % 5 = 1 := by decide
      rw [this] at h₁₄
      have : (1 * (n % 5)) % 5 = 4 % 5 := by rwa [← h₁₄]
      have : n % 5 = 4 := by
        have : (n % 5) % 5 = 4 := by
          simp [Nat.mul_one] at this; assumption
        have h₁₅ : n % 5 < 5 := Nat.mod_lt n (by decide)
        omega
      exact this
    -- Bound m from below: m ≥ 2 since m % 5 = 2 and m > 0
    have h₁₄ : m ≥ 2 := by
      have : m % 5 = 2 := h₁₂
      have : m ≥ 2 := by
        by_contra h
        have : m ≤ 1 := by omega
        interval_cases m <;> simp [h₁₂] at *
      exact this
    -- Bound n from below: n ≥ 4 since n % 5 = 4 and n > 0
    have h₁₅ : n ≥ 4 := by
      have : n % 5 = 4 := h₁₃
      have : n ≥ 4 := by
        by_contra h
        have : n ≤ 3 := by omega
        interval_cases n <;> simp [h₁₃] at *

    have h₁₆ : Nat.lcm (6 * m) (6 * n) = 6 * m * n := by

        rw [Nat.lcm]
      rw [h₁₇, h₄]
      have : (6 * m * 6 * n) / 6 = 6 * m * n := by

          use (m * 6 * n)
          ring

      simp [this]
    rw [h₁₆]

          omega
        exact this
      have h₂₂ : m * n ≤ 17 := by omega
      -- enumerate possibilities
      have h₂₃ : m ≥ 2 := h₁₄
      have h₂₄ : n ≥ 4 := h₁₅
      have h₂₅ : m % 5 = 2 := h₁₂
      have h₂₆ : n % 5 = 4 := h₁₃
      have h₂₇ : Nat.gcd m n = 1 := h₉

        by_contra h
        have : m ≥ 7 := by
          have : m % 5 = 2 := h₂₅
          have : m ≥ 2 := h₂₃

            omega

          | inr h₂₈ => exact h₂₈
        have : m * n ≥ 7 * 4 := by
          nlinarith
        have : m * n ≥ 28 := by omega
        omega

      have : n ≤ 8 := by

          have : m * n ≤ 17 := h₂₂
          rw [this] at h₂₂
          omega
        omega
      have : n ≥ 4 := h₂₄
      have : n % 5 = 4 := h₂₆
      interval_cases n <;> simp_all (config := {decide := true})
    omega
